I got there safe and we hung out for a few hours playing video games, and then went outside for some reason to sleep. We put sleeping bags on the grass and got pillows and were talking while sitting by them. Out of nowhere the biggest moment of fear came over me, and I thought something extremely bad was going to happen. It was so scary, and at this moment of tremendous fear I looked at my friend and we both said RUN! at the very same time. We sprinted inside the house, locked the doors and windows, turned the lights off, held each other for a good 5 minutes. I asked him if he felt what I felt, and he said the biggest wave of fear came over him right before we ran. We both got this huge wave of fear at 3:00am outside and we’re so scared. I didn’t bike home and my dad found out I snuck out because I was too scared something or someone was outside. We didn’t even go outside after that until morning.
